summary: Frontend-only smoke test of Desk Planner create-class flow, setup/roster, student settings drawer, persistence, and classroom map rendering. All major flows pass with no console errors.
passed: Home -> Open Desk Planner -> new-class-btn opens create-class-card
Create card has name input, layout options (pairs/groups), teacher desk (front/back), cancel, continue; continue is disabled when name empty and enabled after typing
Continue navigates to setup page with class-details-panel; class-name-input is prefilled from create card
Add student via add-student-input + Enter and via add-student-btn works
Bulk add via paste-list-btn -> bulk-add-textarea -> bulk-add-submit adds multiple students (newline and comma separated) — 6 students created from 2 single + 4 bulk
Each roster card exposes student-card-{i}, student-settings-btn-{i}, student-delete-btn-{i}

Student settings drawer opens with visibility-low/medium/high, behaviour-low/medium/high, student-settings-notes textarea, near-teacher-switch, apart-chip-{peerId}, apart-strength-{peerId}, together-chip-{peerId}
Selecting a peer as Together removes the Apart link with that peer (card tags updated to show 'Near teacher', 'Together · 1', 'Note' and no 'Apart · n')
Data persists in localStorage key 'desk-planner-db' (1136 bytes) after page reload; class appears on hub as class-row-0 with class-edit-btn-0 and reopens with all 6 students intact

setup-review-map-btn renders Planner: 3 desks (pairs layout), Together pair (Ann & Ben) seated at same desk (DESK 2), Apart pair (Cat on DESK 3, Dee on DESK 1) separated — 'All hard separation rules satisfied', score 87
No console errors across all flows
Mobile viewport 390px: create card and setup render cleanly without overlapping text
notes: Correct hub navigation is via class-edit-btn-0 (Edit setup) rather than clicking the class title text; the title text node is not clickable to open setup. Not a bug — intentional UI.
